title: Sagan's 1975 paper on detecting artificial surface structures

tellings.quote: He also wrote a 75 paper saying that if we want to look for possible signs of technologically advanced life on other planets,

plain: Maaneli Derakhshani, a researcher on Jesse Michels's podcast, says the astronomer Carl Sagan wrote a paper in 1975 about how to look for signs of advanced life on other planets. According to him, Sagan's idea was to search the surfaces of planets for structures that look built rather than natural, which would matter for anyone hunting such signs on Mars or the Moon.
